methodology.primaryOutcome: harness_verified_success; generated code passes the local compile gate and registered behavioral/security checks.
methodology.oracle: Generated code is compiled and checked by the repository runtime suites after generation; this is harness verification, not independent human review.
methodology.contextTreatment: Vanilla, all 11 installed skill entrypoints, or canonical focused selection against the same installed consumer. Saved answers are reevaluated without new generation.
methodology.hiddenOracleTests: Runtime assertions are not included in the model prompt.
methodology.runtimeIsolation: Generated code runs in a permission-limited Node child process with a minimal environment; this is defense in depth, not a hardened OS sandbox.
methodology.chatTokenUsage: Chat UI token usage is unavailable unless manually supplied with the imported response.
methodology.successRateDenominator: Quality success rates use completed evaluator runs; API and evaluator failures are reported separately and excluded from that denominator.
methodology.syntaxGate: Native Node stripTypeScriptTypes in transform mode; no source repair; followed by CommonJS execution and registered assertions. Full TypeScript type checking is not included.

spending.limits: Reservations persist across launches. Unknown or timed-out requests remain reserved. Other project usage is outside this runner.
